_about: Dentist review of Stage 1 numbering on DENTEX validation X-rays (quadrant_enumeration_disease/xrays), from her feedback on dev+0671fd92 (stage1_rect_v1, stage2a_crown256_focal), 2026-11-06. Keys of 'relabel' are the detector's labels she was shown, values the true FDI number. 'candidates_real' / 'candidates_not_teeth' are the 'Possible extra teeth' candidates (uncertain_teeth) she confirmed or rejected. 'missed' are teeth she says the detector didn't find. Caries findings are in dentist_caries_labels.json; 'not_pathology' are other findings she rejected.

val_0.png.unclear: She says '45 is missing' while the detector shows a 45 (and calls 44 missing): either the detector's 45 is really 44, or 45 should be listed as missing.

val_28.png.unclear: She says '14 is 13' and also 'real 13 isn't detected'; one of them may mean the real 14 is the undetected tooth. She also says 24 isn't detected, where the detector had a 24 candidate (possible_numbering_error).
